urls.title: URLs to check
urls.description: One URL per row. Redirects are followed automatically and the final URL is reported back.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages to fetch in parallel. Keep it low to stay polite to target sites.

timeoutMs.title: Request timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout. Slow marketing sites sometimes need 30s.

includeRawBlocks.title: Include raw JSON-LD blocks
includeRawBlocks.description: Attach the parsed JSON-LD blocks to each result. Makes output much larger.
